responsibility: This file implements the pre-register-allocation early rematerialization RTL pass. It identifies pseudo registers in selected modes for which spilling across calls is especially undesirable, collects candidate defining insns, computes reaching definitions and value equivalence among candidates, rejects cyclic or inconsistent rematerializations, and then inserts recomputation sequences at profitable points—typically after calls or at block entries—while tracking availability and liveness across the CFG. It is a target-guided anti-spill optimization aimed at expensive-to-save values such as scalable vector registers.
